title: Wick-dominant non-Gaussian variational scale and endpoint-capacity boundary

variational_boundary.class_lower: For every fixed 0<=beta<c_* and normalized psi with density in M_beta, q0[psi]+g E W_N>=min{kappa C_N/(8a_N),g(c_*-beta)kappa C_N^2/2}=Omega_g(N^4)
variational_boundary.class_upper: The vacuum lies in M_0 and has energy 6gC_N^2=O(N^4), so the M_beta variational bottom is Theta_g(N^4)
variational_boundary.material_scope: The result includes non-Gaussian linear mixes of symmetric independent positive-kurtosis coordinates, elliptical Gaussian scale mixtures and arbitrary phases; it is strictly broader than every Gaussian likelihood classified by K1531
variational_boundary.cat_squeeze_boundary: K1534's exact smooth cat/squeeze family lies outside fixed M_beta as epsilon tends to zero, but its interaction 6g epsilon(2-epsilon)C_N^2 and free lower bound Theta(N^4/epsilon) optimize only at Theta_g(N^4), never N^2
variational_boundary.endpoint_necessity: If a normalized trial has Rayleigh quotient at most K N^2, Markov gives at least one half of its mass on B_N={W_N<=2KN^2/g}; binary entropy plus Gross log-Sobolev then requires -log mu(B_N)=O(N^2)
variational_boundary.endpoint_candidate: For psi_(N,L)=chi(W_N/L)/||chi(W_N/L)|| with chi supported in [0,2] and equal to one on [0,1], the potential is at most 2gL and q0=L^(-2)E[chi'(W_N/L)^2 Gamma_Omega(W_N)]/E[chi(W_N/L)^2]
variational_boundary.carré_du_champ: Gamma_Omega(W_N)=8||Pi_N[(phi_N^2-3C_N)phi_N]||_2^2 in the exact real cutoff normalization, where Pi_N is the full cutoff projector and is distinct from the fixed-ratio shell P_N
variational_boundary.remaining_gate: At L=Theta(N^2), K1518 gives only the necessary lower exponent -log mu(B_N)>=cN^2; an O(N^2) trial requires a matching endpoint capacity and an O(N^2) weighted boundary quotient, while any superquadratic endpoint exponent excludes it
variational_boundary.brst_transfer: Tensoring a classified trial with a harmonic BRST vector preserves only the scoped Rayleigh statement; no continuum interacting charge, physical cohomology or source-owned GU state space follows
variational_boundary.scope_guard: The unrestricted ground energy still has only K1519's Omega(N^2) lower boundary and the existing nonmatching upper descent; no unrestricted N^4 theorem or O(N^2) trial is proved
